forecast-period.text: A vigorous cold front and will move across the west of SA late Saturday then moving across remaining parts of the State on Sunday. A high pressure system moves just to the north on Monday, ahead of another cold front forecast to move across South Australia on Tuesday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Areas of rain across the state, tending to scattered showers from the west during the day and gradually contracting to the agricultural areas during the evening. Possible gusty thunderstorms about the agricultural area and south of the Pastoral districts. Possible raised dust in the northeast. Maximum temperatures below average, but above average in the far northeast. Fresh north to northwesterly winds in the east at first ahead of a fresh to strong and gusty west to southwesterly winds change extending throughout during the day. Winds possibly severe about western coasts from late morning, extending to the Flinders Ranges during the afternoon. Southwesterly winds moderating from the west during the afternoon and evening.

Areas of rain across much of the state apart from the far northeast. The chance of an isolated thunderstorm about western coastal districts, possibly reaching western Kangaroo Island at night. North to northwesterly winds, fresh at times about coastal parts and in the west, ahead of a fresh to strong and gusty west to southwesterly change moving across the west of the state during the evening.

Possible patchy morning frost about the Flinders Ranges and northwest of SA. Scattered showers about the agricultural area, easing and contracting to windward coasts and ranges during the morning, before redeveloping about western and southern coasts during the evening. Maximum temperatures below average. Southwest to northwesterly winds, fresh about central and eastern coasts and ranges during the morning.

Possible morning frost about the northern agricultural area and parts of the Pastoral districts. Scattered showers about the agricultural area, with isolated showers extending into the south of the Pastoral districts. Possible thunderstorms about windward coasts and ranges. Maximum temperatures below average. Freshening north to northwesterly winds ahead of a fresh to strong and gusty west to southwesterly change extending eastwards during the day.

text.p: Possible morning frost about the northern agricultural area and parts of the Pastoral districts. Showers about the agricultural area, contracting to windward coasts and ranges during the evening. Maximum temperatures below average. West to southwesterly winds, fresh about coastal parts and in the northeast, easing during the day. Winds tending southwest to southeasterly in the west later in the day.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Tuesday: Falls of 5 to 15 mm across much of the state, increasing 15 to 30 mm about the agricultural areas, Eyre Peninsula, Flinders Ranges and south of the Pastoral districts, and increasing further to 25 to 50 mm about western facing coasts and ranges. Local falls of 40 to 70 mm are possible about the Mount Lofty Ranges, Flinders Ranges and with thunderstorms. Less than 2 mm about the far northeast.
